reason: Free listing I'd take, since they load the flyers themselves and it costs me nothing. But paying €39 for a push and a badge? My Instagram already does the job and my friend handles it.
objection: My competitors will be on it too, so what do I gain? And there are no users yet, so I'd be paying to be seen by nobody.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app really full of people in my city, and proof that my nights get people through the door, before I pay anything.
